notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25890156/713834ccb5f280dde2d6fd0172a3f8bdcad2508d.png[/img]

Dear friends, we have great news!

Today we released a global update for One Day in London! It concerns an update to the text from all chapters. This work was carried out in collaboration with native speakers, and we have worked to improve the style and quality of the text.

Now you'll be even closer to the atmosphere of Victorian London!

We are grateful to all of you who have sent us feedback so far — comments, questions, and reviews. The game has become better with your help, so thank you! 

And, of course, we're always happy to receive more feedback — send yours to info@owl-studio.net!

notes.title: The new update is here!
RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25890156/dfcf9401bc8a6347a0d58bcd44a934d71cd00cbf.jpg[/img]

Dear Friends, 
We are finally ready to announce the release date of the final chapter of One Day in London on Steam — May 17, 2018!

Next week, you will be able to return to your thrilling adventures in occult London — where new secrets and long-desired answers await. Everything is in your hands — how the story ends depends entirely on your decisions.

We would just like to say that we are extremely grateful to all of you for choosing us, believing in us and staying with us on this journey. Without your feedback, suggestions, stories and fan art, One Day in London would not be what it is today. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you!

Yours Sincerely,
OWL Studio

notes.title: Release day is approaching!
Update #2
notes.notes:
We made corrections to the game and fixed several pesky bugs:
1. We sped up the in-game loading
2. Fixed music problem with manual saves
3. Fixed looping dialog with Valahar
4. It’s easier to get Charlie’s minigame now
5. Fixed some text problems
6. Fixed sudden appearance of Mary in new save files.

A lot of mistakes were found because of your feedback. Thank you for writing us!

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your feedback! We fixed several bugs you pointed out in comments:
- End game freeze in one of the storylines
- Achievement display
- Small text errors and mascot placements

If you encountered save problem, please send this folder contents:
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Owl Studio/One Day In London to our e-mail: info@owl-studio.net
And tell us if you deleted the game before playing fourth chapter and if you used Steam Cloud.

If you encounter any other bugs or errors, please don’t hesitate to send us your comments. We’ll do everything we can to fix it.

notes.title: Update №2! Version 2.0.3.2
notes.notes:
Over the past week and a half we’ve made some improvements:
- Fixed the reason of game crashes
- Fixed the error in the mini-game with picking the lock
- Fixed the error with the running symbol in mini-games
- Fixed the error with graphics and UI
- The type of arrows at locations was changed
- Misprints and other errors in text are fixed

Thank you all who sent us your bugs!
We remind that if you deal with any errors, feel free to send their description, screenshots and error log to our e-mail: info@owl-studio.net

If your game still crashes, please send us a message with your computer specifications and specifically your operating system bit set (32 or 64).

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
We’re releasing an update for the game with a lot of small fixes and additions:
- Fixed several small art bugs
- Fixed text cutting off in logs
- Hints for mini-games in the Third Episode are added
- Every mini-game can now be skipped
- Videos can be skipped only by pressing Space, Enter or by using mouse (you can now take screenshot without skipping video)
- Menu can be opened or closed by pressing Esc
- “Skip” button is added to every mini-game
And other small fixes.

If you encounter any problems, please, tell us. It will help us improve the game!

notes.title: Update Release!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25890156/398ba19920764562e6f04bdcb484a4a58a522aea.jpg[/img]

Today we are updating first two chapters.

We have fully optimized the game engine, redesigned the save system and added a startup menu. Relationship system of the first chapter has also been updated.
If you have problems running the update, we would be very grateful if you report it.

The Third Chapter will come out soon!

notes.title: Here comes our first update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25890156/c6519db4e46146233a0d1dc43940228b33415fa5.jpg[/img]
We do like feedback. So we collected your wishes in this first update which includes:
- new saving system and Steam Cloud, no more bugs!
- mini-games improvement: now there are tips for the most challenging puzzles and the ability to skip drawing runes
Please leave your suggestions how to improve the game. See you in London ;)
